description: This file contains architecture-specific function declarations and inline functions for x86 kernel operations in the Zephyr RTOS, including CPU exception handling, user space management, and interrupt vector management.

methods.name: arch_is_in_isr
methods.description: Inline function to determine if the CPU is currently handling an interrupt service routine.

methods.name: z_x86_unhandled_cpu_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled CPU exceptions, dumps info, and calls fatal error handler.

methods.name: z_x86_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles unrecoverable errors by dumping registers and transferring control.

methods.name: z_x86_check_stack_bounds
methods.description: Checks if a memory address range falls within the thread's stack bounds.

methods.name: z_x86_userspace_enter
methods.description: Enters user space mode with specified thread entry point and stack parameters.

methods.name: z_x86_userspace_prepare_thread
methods.description: Prepares a thread for user space execution, returning its initial entry point.

methods.name: z_x86_allocate_vector
methods.description: Allocates an IRQ vector at a given priority.

methods.name: z_x86_irq_connect_on_vector
methods.description: Connects an interrupt handler to a specific vector.
